record.capability: Actual native OFOP and ManifestWriter package SAX consumers
assertions: OFOP WriteRelationsInfoSequence and WriteContentSequence now consume actual XOutputStream/context/native StringPair sequences and registered source Writer. Attribute admission and failure occur in original order after root callbacks. Actual ManifestWriter implements the original XManifestWriter/XServiceInfo component, acquired context, exact package2 registration, native PropertyValue sequences and original SAXException-to-WrappedTargetRuntimeException wrapping with empty outer Message/Context. ManifestExport consumes the actual XDocumentHandler reference/native nested sequences and queries the original extended facet after startDocument. The duplicate XmlStringDocumentHandler encoder and five-callback alias are removed. Existing package string boundaries only bind actual native containers/stream bytes; no replacement XML encoder, fake provider or lazy core bootstrap exists. Dedicated Worker entrypoints own realm-local services; test fixtures initialize the same actual registry. Plain unencrypted OASIS admission remains bounded; legacy/encryption, full Sfx metadata/storage and final DOCX/XLSX core/shell/UI acceptance remain unfinished. Native physical ABI/allocator/debug/binary/timing parity is unqualified; previous coverage gaps stay open.
